description: Canadian data residency: models and data stores in Canada, regional (Standard) processing only

model_region.why: The Foundry resource (and so its Standard deployments) is in Canada

model_deployment_type.why: Prompts and answers are processed only in the resource's region (Global and Data Zone types can process elsewhere)

data_store_region.why: Search indexes, traces and other connected stores are in Canada

content_filter.why: Every model deployment needs an Azure AI content filter policy

prompt_shields.why: Jailbreak attempts in user prompts are detected and blocked

key_auth_disabled.why: Only Entra ID identities can call the resource (no shared API keys)

private_network.why: The Foundry resource is reachable only through private endpoints

tracing_enabled.why: UAT feedback and traces are recorded in Application Insights
